title: HaloRank
description: Adds a customizable halo rank system with toggle support and syncing.
body:
Added a customizable Halo ranking system with support for switching and syncing. There are 7 ranks in total: S, A, B, C, D, E, F. This mod is for both client and server use.
How to use:
/setrank <player> <rank>
Hide RankHalo
/halo hide
Show RankHalo
/halo show
